description: This file defines the AdvancedQueryRequest class, an immutable data transfer object used for representing advanced query data within the Fineract project. It includes fields for a base query and multiple table queries, along with methods to check for filters and result columns.

classes.name: AdvancedQueryRequest
classes.description: Immutable data object representing datatable data, with fields for a base query and a list of table queries, and methods to evaluate filters and result columns.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Checks whether the request has any filters set in the base query or in any of the table queries.

methods.name: hasResultColumn
methods.description: Checks whether the request has any result columns set in the base query or in any of the table queries.
